496:t_1:3.en: ～ Outer-Space Mothership $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ Bridge ～

496:t_1:4.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...Captain $$ジンネマン$$. Thank you for guarding $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$.」

496:t_1:5.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「It was nothing much. This ship's stealth system is nearly perfect.」

496:t_1:6.en:
$$オットー$$
「Even the $$サイデリアル$$ can't do anything about us if we keep changing position often.」

496:t_1:7.en:
$$ナナイ$$
「Meanwhile, on our side, we gathered anti-$$ネオ・ジオン$$ forces and supported the organizations carrying out guerrilla-style activities in various regions.」

496:t_1:8.en:
$$シャア$$
「I'm putting you through a lot too, $$ナナイ$$. And...」

496:t_1:9.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「There is no need for needless concern, $$シャア$$. I am only doing everything I can as the Princess of $$ジオン$$.」

496:t_1:11.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「After we finish resupplying here, we intend to keep $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s movements in check.」

496:t_1:12.en:
$$ナナイ$$
「Understood. I will explain the current state of space around $$蒼の地球$$.」

496:t_1:16.en: ～ $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ $$ヴェーダ$$ Core ～

496:t_1:18.en:
$$ガロード$$
「How is it, $$ティファ$$?」

496:t_1:19.en:
$$ティファ$$
「...No good. I can't feel anything from $$ヴェーダ$$...」

496:t_1:20.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「You made contact with $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$, so I thought your brain quantum waves might, perhaps... but...」

496:t_1:22.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「It's nothing for you to worry about, $$ティファ$$. Thank you for lending your strength.」

496:t_1:23.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Looks like $$ティエリア$$ isn't too down about it.」

496:t_1:25.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Is that okay? The information on $$クロノ$$ should be inside $$ヴェーダ$$, right?」

496:t_1:26.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「What can't be done can't be done. Getting impatient won't help.」

496:t_1:27.en:
$$パーラ$$
「So this $$クロノ$$ is in all sorts of worlds, pulling the strings of history from the shadows, right?」

496:t_1:28.en:
$$パーラ$$
「I don't get it. What were those guys even doing all that for?」

496:t_1:29.en:
$$ガロード$$
「If $$ヴェーダ$$ had answered, we might have learned everything about $$クロノ$$.」

496:t_1:30.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「We can find that answer ourselves, with our own hands, in the battles ahead.」

496:t_1:32.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「The old me wouldn't have managed this.」

496:t_1:33.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「But through the battles with $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ and $c, I learned the meaning of overcoming hardship.」

496:t_1:34.en:
$$パーラ$$
「Maybe $$ヴェーダ$$ has been silent all this time to teach us things like that.」

496:t_1:35.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「...A trial... Is that what it is...」

496:t_1:36.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(If it's the $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$, it's not unthinkable...)

496:t_1:37.en:
$$ティエリア$$
($$イオリア$$ was pushing ahead with the $$イノベイター$$ plan while evading $$クロノ$$'s eyes...)

496:t_1:38.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(Most likely, what $$クロノ$$ calls managing humanity's evolution means, in effect, halting humanity's evolution...)

496:t_1:40.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「I'm fine, $$ティファ$$. ...As an $$イノベイド$$ who guides humanity's evolution, I consider the fight against $$クロノ$$ my own mission.」

496:t_1:43.en:
$$ティファ$$
「$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$ said the power I have is not humanity's evolved form.」

496:t_1:44.en:
$$ティファ$$
「That's exactly why, if humanity is going to evolve, I want to see it.」

496:t_1:47.en:
$$ティエリア$$
($$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$... If $$クロノ$$ exists as the ones blocking the future of humanity that you entrusted to us, I will overcome them.)

496:t_1:48.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(And as an $$イノベイド$$, I will see with my own eyes what lies ahead for the $$イノベイター$$... what lies ahead of the life $$刹那$$ lives.)

496:t_1:53.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「$$イアン$$, this part here is for the $$ハルート$$, right!?」

496:t_1:54.en:
$$イアン$$
「Oh, that's right! Leave the $$サバーニャ$$ to $$アストナージ$$, and you handle the footwork over there!」

496:t_1:55.en:
$$リンダ$$
「These are parts developed at the Jupiter base, assembled here. All that's left is to equip them on each unit.」

496:t_1:56.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Oss, understood! So this makes the Gundams of $$ロックオン$$, $$アレルヤ$$, and $$ティエリア$$ more powerful!」

496:t_1:57.en:
$$リンダ$$
「We also managed to boost the output of the colony Gundams and the $$トールギスⅢ$$ by swapping each part for the latest ones.」

496:t_1:58.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Did $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ modify $$ヒイロ$$ and the others' Gundams?」

496:t_1:59.en:
$$リンダ$$
「Former $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ engineers were involved in developing those Gundams. So some parts share the same standards.」

496:t_1:60.en:
$$リンダ$$
「Though $$ウイングゼロ$$, the culmination of their technology, has a lot of its own systems, so we couldn't touch it...」

496:t_1:61.en:
$$イアン$$
「While we were at it, we got suits ready for them too. Fighting the battles ahead in light gear would be rough.」

496:t_1:62.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「That's what I call a generous gesture.」

496:t_1:63.en:
$$イアン$$
「It's not only the Gundams being upgraded. Through Commander $$レディ・アン$$, we also received a program to activate $$トランザム$$ using a pseudo-$$ＧＮドライヴ$$.」

496:t_1:64.en:
$$イアン$$
「With that installed, the units of Major $$グラハム$$ and Lieutenant $$コーラサワー$$ will be able to use $$トランザム$$ too.」

496:t_1:65.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「So now it's the age of $$トランザム$$ for non-Gundams too...」

496:t_1:66.en:
$$リンダ$$
「But adjusting it requires the utmost care.」

496:t_1:67.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Leave it to me, $$リンダ$$. As $$タクヤ・イレイ$$, $$イアン$$'s number-one apprentice, I'll show you flawless work!」

496:t_1:68.en:
$$イアン$$
「You're a smooth talker. Not long ago you were calling $$アストナージ$$ your master.」

496:t_1:69.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「To me, every mechanic on $c is a master!」

496:t_1:70.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Amazing, $$タクヤ$$... You're already trusted with servicing the Gundams completely?」

496:t_1:71.en:
$$ハロ$$
「$$タクヤ$$, working hard! $$タクヤ$$, working hard!」

496:t_1:72.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Times like these, I have to become a full-fledged mechanic too.」

496:t_1:73.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Some day I might even become your personal mechanic for the $$ユニコーン$$.」

496:t_1:74.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I won't get my hopes up. I'll just wait.」

496:t_1:75.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Hey, you! You're not taking me seriously!」

496:t_1:76.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「It might not be a joke at all. $$タクヤ$$ has studied the $$ユニコーン$$ a lot.」

496:t_1:77.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The modification plan he showed me the other day was pretty well done, too.」

496:t_1:79.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「It's still a secret from you. I'm having $$カミーユ$$ coach me right now while I recalculate the weight balance.」

496:t_1:80.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「More importantly, give me a hand too, $$バナージ$$. Compared to the $$サバーニャ$$, the $$ハルート$$ is getting a major refit, so we need the manpower.」

496:t_1:81.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I'll help you with that one, $$タクヤ$$.」

496:t_1:83.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You rest for a bit. Look...」

496:t_1:84.en:
$$ミコット$$
「$$バナージ$$... I brought Lady $$ミネバ$$.」

496:t_1:85.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Please stop, $$ミコット$$. We're the ones who sorted laundry together, aren't we?」

496:t_1:86.en:
$$ミコット$$
「That's right. By the end, you'd gotten more efficient at it than me.」

496:t_1:87.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I was a member of the $c housekeeping team too.」
